snippets.snippet_text: "Starting in February 2024, all sales commissions available for withdrawal in any currency, except BRL (real), are automatically transferred without a withdrawal fee once a month to the bank account you registered on our platform."

"If you request the withdrawal by noon (GMT-3), the payment will be made by the next business day. Requests made after noon (GMT-3) or on non-business days will be processed by the second business day after approval."
